nodes.label: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision (U-OPSD)
nodes.author: Yijiang Li, Bingyang Wang, Yijun Liang, Yunjie Tian, Di Fu, Nuno Vasconcelos
nodes.rationale: Proposes unsupervised on-policy self-distillation using majority-vote consensus from model's own rollouts as pseudo-solution for teacher conditioning, eliminating need for ground-truth labels.

nodes.label: Unsupervised On-Policy Self-Distillation (U-OPSD)
nodes.rationale: Method replacing ground-truth supervision in OPSD with pseudo-labels from majority-vote consensus, enabling self-distillation without external supervision.

nodes.label: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)
nodes.rationale: Baseline method using same model as teacher and student under different conditioning contexts, with teacher conditioned on ground-truth solution.

nodes.label: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
nodes.rationale: RL baseline using verifiable reward normalized within group of sampled rollouts; provides sparse sequence-level signal.

nodes.label: Self-Consistency Voting
nodes.rationale: Majority voting over multiple rollouts to construct pseudo-answer and partition rollouts into agreeing and disagreeing sets for distillation.

nodes.label: Math Reasoning Benchmarks (AIME24, AIME25, HMMT25, MATH500, AMC23)
nodes.rationale: Competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks used for evaluating U-OPSD across multiple model scales and reasoning modes.

nodes.label: Qwen3 Models (4B, 8B, 30B-A3B, Instruct variants)
nodes.rationale: Model family used for evaluating U-OPSD in both thinking and non-thinking modes.
